# sha256 of each pinned download. Generated by fetch-checksums.sh.
# Do not edit by hand: a hash here must come from the real artifact.
#
# Empty on purpose. No hash is written here until fetch-checksums.sh has
# downloaded the artifact and measured it, because a guessed hash is worse than
# none: it would verify nothing while looking verified. build.sh refuses to
# build while this file has no entries, and the image build fails closed if a
# tool it needs has none.
